data.body_html:
Start your morning on the Mediterranean with a Marbella dolphin watching brunch cruise—a two-hour private charter from Puerto Banús that combines wildlife spotting with a relaxed brunch. From €749 for up to 9 guests, this experience includes a licensed skipper, fuel, food, and drinks. It's one of the most memorable ways to begin a day on the Costa del Sol.

What to Expect on Your Dolphin Watching Brunch Cruise

Departing at 10:00 from Puerto Banús, your private boat heads west toward Cabopino or east toward Cala del Faro—areas where dolphins are frequently spotted. The morning light is ideal for spotting dorsal fins breaking the surface. Your skipper knows the local hotspots and will adjust course to give you the best chance of a sighting. Meanwhile, a brunch spread of pastries, fruit, and light snacks is served alongside cava, white wine, beer, or soft drinks. The entire cruise is private, so it's just your group on board.

Which Boats Are Available?

We offer two boats for this experience:

  • Astondoa 40 – 12.5m, up to 9 guests, €749 for 2 hours
  • Azimut 39 – 12.5m, up to 11 guests, €749 for 2 hours

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, brunch, drinks, insurance, and IVA. Choose based on your group size. For larger parties (up to 12), consider our other boat options via WhatsApp.

Where Will We See Dolphins?

The waters off Marbella are home to common dolphins and bottlenose dolphins. Your skipper will head toward areas like Cabopino (west of Puerto Banús) or Cala del Faro (east), where dolphins often feed in the morning. The 10:00 departure is deliberate—calmer seas and lower boat traffic mean dolphins are more active and visible. On most trips, you'll see them swimming alongside the bow or leaping in the distance.

What’s Included in the Brunch?

Your brunch includes fresh pastries, seasonal fruit, light sandwiches or savoury bites, plus your choice of cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks, and water. Dietary requirements can be accommodated—just let us know when booking via WhatsApp. The food is served on board, with no need to stop at a restaurant.

Why Choose a Morning Cruise?

Morning cruises offer cooler temperatures, fewer crowds, and the best light for photography. The sea is typically calmer, making it a smoother ride for anyone prone to seasickness. Plus, you're back at Puerto Banús by 12:00, leaving the rest of the day free for other Marbella activities.

How to Book

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and send payment details. Prices start at €749 for the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39. For other boats (e.g., Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours), pricing is on request.
